newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuels firm with futures, diffs stable.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuels firm with futures, diffs stable.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices firmed with NYMEX heating oil futures on Tuesday afternoon, amid moderate activity, industry sources said.
Airline-quality 54-grade jet fuel differentials were stable from Monday, with offers heard at 1.25 cents over the October NYMEX print.
Prices in New York Harbor were also stable with bids on 54-grade holding at 4.25 to 4.50 cents over October futures.
-- Franklin Paul, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
